defaultExplain.en: Electronic advertising messages in Germany require prior express consent (UWG §7), which also covers WhatsApp; the channel is blocked for prospecting.
defaultExplain.fr: En Allemagne, les messages publicitaires électroniques requièrent un consentement exprès préalable (UWG §7), ce qui couvre aussi WhatsApp ; le canal est bloqué pour la prospection.

note: No primary German source is listed in docs/compliance/outreach-compliance.md yet; add one (UWG §7) during legal review.
